name: Elixir Capital Limited
summary: Elixir Capital Limited, together with its subsidiaries, trades and invests in shares and securities in India. The company offers stock and commodity broking, arbitrage and proprietary trading, demat, and portfolio management services. It also provides capital market research and analysis services, as well as depository services. Elixir Capital Limited was formerly known as Axis Capital Markets (India) Limited and changed its name to Elixir Capital Limited in September 2015. Elixir Capital Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
